sources.title: Gold Steadies Near 14-Month Low as Rate-Hike Pressure Mounts
Dollar holds near 19-month high as data supports case for US rate hikes

en.title: Gold steadies near 14-month low; dollar holds near 19-month high
en.dek: Gold and dollar move on rate-hike expectations amid market data on 18 November 2026
facts: Gold steadied near a 14-month low on 18 November 2026 as rate-hike pressure mounted, according to Bloomberg.
The dollar held near a 19-month high on 18 November 2026 as data supported the case for US rate hikes, according to WTVB.
Bloomberg reported gold steadied near a 14-month low amid mounting rate-hike pressure.
WTVB reported the dollar held near a 19-month high as data supported the case for US rate hikes.
body: Gold steadied near a 14-month low on 18 November 2026 as rate-hike pressure mounted, according to Bloomberg. The metal's price remained under pressure from expectations of higher US interest rates.

The dollar held near a 19-month high on 18 November 2026 as economic data supported the case for US rate hikes, according to WTVB. Strong economic indicators reinforced expectations that the Federal Reserve would maintain or raise interest rates.
en.context: Markets reacted to US economic data and interest-rate expectations in mid-November 2026.

zh.title: 黄金接近14个月低点 美元维持19个月高位
zh.dek: 受市场数据影响 黄金和美元在2026年11月18日围绕加息预期波动
facts: 根据彭博社 2026年11月18日受加息压力增大 黄金稳定在14个月低点附近
根据WTVB 2026年11月18日数据支持美联储加息的论点 美元维持在19个月高点附近
彭博社报道 黄金在加息压力增大背景下稳定在14个月低点附近
WTVB报道 美元在数据支持美联储加息的论点下维持在19个月高点附近
body: 黄金在11月18日持于14个月低位附近，因加息压力加剧，路透社报道。金价受预期上升的美国利率的压力持续施压。
美元在11月18日持于19个月高位附近，因经济数据支持了美国加息的可能性，WTVB报道。强劲的经济指标加强了联邦储备维持或上调利率的预期。
zh.context: 市场对2026年11月中旬的美国经济数据和利率预期做出了反应
